propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling to 32767 (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT), which is the default value of the admin-settable property jira.text.field.character.limit but not its only valid value

when a DC administrator raises or sets jira.text.field.character.limit above 32767 or to 0 (unlimited), rebar silently truncates comments that Jira would accept, causing permanent local/remote body divergence
the fix makes comment_max_chars configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars (default 32767, range 0 to 2147483647), allowing operators to match their instance's ceiling
sanitize_comment and fit_comment must be decoupled from the description fitter to prevent future changes to description fitting from inadvertently retargeting comments
/rest/api/2/application-properties endpoint for auto-discovery is admin-only (403 to non-admin PAT), making configuration the only viable remedy for ordinary user credentials
